subject: FIRE EXTINGUISHER SYSTEM

_anchors.NFPA 17 / 17A: dry and wet chemical extinguishing systems

_sparse_note: For portable extinguishers there is genuinely nothing to start up — placement, charge and tag are the whole check. The engineered systems (kitchen suppression) carry the real content, and their discharge testing is acceptance scope.

items.note: Installed-and-proven for the SHUTDOWN interlock only. Discharge testing of the agent is acceptance scope — see BACKBURNER 7b.

items.note: Installed and operable. Proof of the alarm response is IST scope, per the placement law.
